component.name: chess.skay
component.summary: Offline chess with a local engine, clocks and hints

description.p: chess.skay is a desktop chess application for Linux. It supports the full rules of chess, a local Python engine with four difficulty levels, clocks with increment, hints, PGN import and export, and five board themes.
The application is self-contained. It does not require a Python installation, an external chess engine, or a network connection.
